comment: Dr. Ransom is amazing! The best professor at UR. She cares about her students and is always there. She makes class fun and interesting,

Dr. Ransom is a great teacher who really seeks to communicate a clear understanding of course material to her students.  Each class is focused around a meaningful discussion and she mixes in various forms of media throughout the duration of the course to enhance discussion and appeal to different learning styles. Overall 5-star professor.
Research Methods- She does a great job of taking a boring subject and making it interesting.  Knowledgeable and flexible with due dates and schedules.  Great lady!

Ransom is an awesome professor. She is extremely passionate about her students and does whatever she can to help them when they ask for it. She understands the difficulties of being a college student and tries to make class discussion more interesting. Class participation is vital for success in the class and she can be a tough grader on papers.

She's an awesome lady. I would recommend her for any class. She listened to the students thoughts and opinions about the class, which gave everyone the exoerience they wanted. The class was Deciphering a Meal and both the midterm and final were easy, but she was a harder grader when it came to papers. DEFINTLY RECOMMEND!

She's my academic advisor. I've never taken a class with her, but she's an absolutely amazing person. Incredibly helpful and empathetic, young and vibrant, and passionate about her job. I look forward to taking a class with her in the future!
I think she is alright, the subjects in class we discuss are interesting but there is alot of reading I mean alot! If you keep up with reading and notes the tests aren't too tough.

Great teacher who motivates her students to take interest in Sociology.  The readings, although long, aren't too boring and most of the time not all that neccesary.  There are a lot of in class films and discussions.  She livens lecture up as well.
Dr. Ransom is funny and knowlegable.  She's a stickler for good grammar tho.  Watch out!
Don't take any other classes by besides SOC 101, you're in for a whole new ball game if you do. Hope you like Application exams.

I would definately reccomend taking Intro to Soc with Dr. Ransom.  The topics discussed in class are fairly interesting, and though some of the readins are boring and sometimes she rushes through material, it's an overall enjoyable, easy class.  Visit her outside of class!
Since taking her class, I am really interested in Sociology.  Class is interesting, but not too hard.  Readings are good too.
Very interresting readings and good discussion.  Not too much homework, the occasional movie in class, and lots of allusions to sports.  She really sparked my interest in Sociology.
